user.title: GardenRX
user.description: Connect Home Assistant to the GardenRX add-on. The add-on must be installed and running; it usually sets this up itself from the tile under Discovered.

hassio_confirm.title: GardenRX
hassio_confirm.description: Set up the GardenRX add-on so Home Assistant gets the harvest, spray and stock sensors, the services, and the cards?

log_harvest.name: Log a harvest
log_harvest.description: Record a pick, the same as the panel's Log Harvest. A pick inside a pre-harvest interval is saved and the response says so.

crop.name: Crop
crop.description: The crop's name (or its id). Part of a name is enough when only one crop matches.

variety.name: Variety
variety.description: Optional. The variety's name or id.

weight.name: Amount
weight.description: How much was picked, in the unit below.

unit.name: Unit
unit.description: lb, oz, kg, g, or ct for a count.

date.name: Date
date.description: The day it was picked. Left out, today.

delete_harvest.name: Delete a harvest
delete_harvest.description: Remove a logged pick by its id (shown on the harvest sensor's recent picks).

complete_queued_spray.name: Mark a queued spray done
complete_queued_spray.description: Log a queued spray as sprayed, the same as the panel: the spray is recorded, the queue entry removed, and what it used comes out of inventory.

id.name: Queued spray id
id.description: Shown on the queued sprays sensor.

volume_gallons.name: Sprayer volume
volume_gallons.description: Gallons mixed. Left out, the panel's default sprayer size.

date.name: Date
date.description: The day it was sprayed. Left out, today.

delete_queued_spray.name: Remove a queued spray
delete_queued_spray.description: Drop a planned spray without logging it.

id.name: Queued spray id
id.description: Shown on the queued sprays sensor.

refresh.name: Refresh
refresh.description: Read the garden from the add-on now instead of waiting for the next poll.
